_comment: Provenance ledger for every shipped audio file â€” the audio analog of resources/textures/source/CC0_SOURCES.json. One row per file: either {generator, script, deterministic, verified} for synthesized audio or {source_url, license, author} for fetched assets. CatalogValidation (tests/core/AudioSystemTest.cpp) fails if a disk file has no row. 'verified' = the byte hash was reproduced by re-running the generator on the date given.

click.wav.script: tools/generate_sounds.py (generate_click: 1 kHz sine, exp decay, 0.1 s)

whoosh.wav.script: tools/generate_sounds.py (generate_whoosh: windowed noise + 5 Hz LFO, 1.0 s)
whoosh.wav.note: unseeded random.uniform â€” shipped bytes (md5 91a7e88c...) not reproducible; format and duration match the generator exactly

place.wav.script: historical generate_click-format output (8864 bytes = 0.1 s mono 16-bit 44.1 kHz); exact parameters unrecorded

test.wav.script: historical generate_whoosh-format output (88244 bytes = 1.0 s mono 16-bit 44.1 kHz); exact parameters unrecorded
test.wav.note: predates provenance tracking (file dated 2025-12-11); debug asset, not referenced by gameplay

axe_chop.wav.script: tools/gen_chop_sound.py (crack + 90 Hz knock + rumble, rng seed 7, 0.28 s)

hit.wav.script: tools/gen_hit_sound.py (woody click + 180 Hz tap, rng seed 11, 0.15 s)
